Approvals.metaDescription: Understand institutional approval and programme accreditation, and consult ANAQ-Sup's opinions.
Approvals.title: Understanding and consulting ANAQ-Sup's opinions
Approvals.lead: ANAQ-Sup evaluates higher education institutions and programmes and publishes its opinions to inform students, families and employers.
Approvals.institutionsText: Approval authorises a higher education institution to award degrees. Consult the list of institutions and the opinion issued for each one.
Approvals.programmesText: Accreditation recognises the quality of a programme (bachelor's, master's, doctorate…). Consult the list of programmes and the opinion issued for each one.
Approvals.favourableText: The institution or programme meets the quality requirements assessed. The year shows when the opinion was issued.
Approvals.unfavourableText: The requirements assessed are not met as of the date of the opinion.
Approvals.note: Texts to be validated by ANAQ-Sup. For any question about an opinion, please use the <link>Contact</link> page.
